candidate_relations.reason: The record describes idiopathic, noninflammatory, symmetric varioliform facial macular atrophy with reduced dermal elastic fibers, supporting AMVC; follicular atrophoderma is a separate entity characterized by follicle-centered depressions, typically at acral sites or in a genodermatosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Distinct follicular atrophy disorder rather than atrophia maculosa varioliformis cutis.
